english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken Cantonese way to mean “very” or “extremely” before an adjective, as in 好搞笑 for “wickedly funny.”
Use this before an adjective when “abundantly” means extremely or very much.

examples.jyutping: ne1 tou3 hei3 hou2 gaau2 siu3 gaa3

examples.english: These fish balls are abundantly spicy; I can’t handle even one.
examples.traditional: 呢碗辣魚蛋好辣，食一粒已經頂唔順。
examples.jyutping: ne1 wun2 laat6 jyu4 daan2 hou2 laat6 sik6 jat1 nap1 ji5 ging1 ding2 m4 seon6
